content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Unattended retail payment terminals and vending software for machine operators; no card manufacturing or card personalization."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Banknote validators, cash handling and currency security paper; different products and customers from payment card production."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Billing and customer care software for telecom and pay-TV operators; not card manufacturing or issuance."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Transaction processing and banking technology services; it processes payments rather than manufacturing or personalizing cards."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Point-of-sale hardware and restaurant or retail software sold to merchants; a different product and customer set."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Mailing equipment, postage meters and parcel shipping for businesses; mail presort overlaps only slightly with card fulfillment."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Merchant payment processing and B2B payables software for small businesses; it processes payments rather than making cards."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Operating subsidiary CompoSecure makes metal payment cards sold to banks and card issuers, matching the target's core card business; the holding structure differs."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Medical, dental and infection prevention products plus health information services; unrelated to payment card manufacturing."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cash-in-transit, ATM services and security logistics for banks and retailers; a service business without card manufacturing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Barcode printers, mobile computers and scanners sold to enterprises; hardware for tracking, not payment or ID card production."}]}
